decisions.reason: As a core rye bread that survived its first review and uses existing recipes, production routines and channels, it likely meets or stays close enough to aspiration levels to be retained.
This seeded rye mixed bread fits the established assortment with low incremental resource demands, so management would usually keep it unless its results clearly fall short of comparable breads.

The dark barley malt rye bread remains more niche and somewhat overlapping with other rye products, but absent clear evidence of persistent underperformance relative to aspirations it is still more likely to be continued than dropped.

After dropping the other new stollen, the marzipan Christmas stollen likely remains the viable seasonal offering and would be kept unless the holiday results disappoint against the firm’s own past seasonal benchmarks.
